statement: A node with an absent `provenance` key must NOT be treated as authored (or any tier above reconstructed) -- doing so silently inflates the golden fraction with unverified data.
wrong_treatment_a_non_conformant_impleme: treats the absent-provenance node as provenance='authored' (rank 0)
reason: The absent case has NO evidence behind it. Defaulting it to a trusted tier (rather than the lowest tier, reconstructed) is exactly the silent promotion PROV-003 forbids. A validator MUST reject an implementation that ranks this node above reconstructed.
